# Session handoff

- Task and state: [approved task; complete / partial / reference-only].
- Files and scope: [actual greeting, plan and configuration paths; reviewed changes].
- Evidence: [named worker activity; actual command, exit status and full stdout, or NOT RUN].
- Not run / limitations: [missing checks, unavailable tools, pending decisions].
- Next action: [one bounded action; no execution or edits without approval].
- Fresh-chat inputs: [this note's actual path, analysis_plan.md, greeting and relevant rules/agents/skills].
